Page sizes and rotation

Source: R/pages.R
pdf_pages.Rd

One row per page, from each page's dictionary and the attributes it inherits from the page tree (MediaBox, CropBox, Rotate).

Usage

pdf_pages(pdf)

Arguments

pdf

A pdf_file from pdf_open().

Value

A data frame with columns page, width, height, rotate (0, 90, 180 or 270, clockwise), media_box and crop_box (list columns of four numbers, NA when the file gives none) and streams (the number of content streams).

Details

Boxes are c(x1, y1, x2, y2) in PDF points (1/72 inch), with the origin at the bottom left. The crop box defaults to the media box and is clipped to it. width and height are the crop box's, before rotation.

Examples

pdf <- pdf_open(system.file("examples", "hello.pdf", package = "zupdf"))
pdf_pages(pdf)
#>   page width height rotate      media_box       crop_box streams
#> 1    1   612    792      0 0, 0, 612, 792 0, 0, 612, 792       1
#> 2    2   612    792      0 0, 0, 612, 792 0, 0, 612, 792       1
pdf_close(pdf)
